ns0:g.ns0:text: A capacitor stores electric-field energy between oppositely charged plates
Ideal linear capacitor with passive current reference entering the positive terminal. Parallel plates: C=εA/d neglecting fringing. Electric field stores
energy; an ideal capacitor does not dissipate it. q is charge on the positive-reference plate.
